result.summary: Found 1 issue: a loading spinner overlay incorrectly displayed on a restaurant image that already appears fully loaded.

issues.description: The Tokumaru Ramen Bar image shows a circular loading spinner overlaid on top of the fully rendered food image, suggesting a stuck or broken loading state.
issues.suggestion: Ensure the loading spinner is hidden once the image asset has finished rendering, or fix the image load event handler so the spinner is properly dismissed.
